title: Lesson 8.5: Measuring performance honestly
use: Lesson 8.5 page in the Whop course.

scenes.vo: Lesson eight point five. Measuring performance honestly.

scenes.sub: Measure your results so deposits, withdrawals and lucky markets don't fool you.
scenes.vo: Measure your results so deposits, withdrawals and lucky markets don't fool you.
scenes.cap: Measure your results so deposits, withdrawals and lucky markets don't fool you.

scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: Time-weighted return (time-weighted return): chains the return of each period, ignoring when you added or removed money. It measures your decisions. Money-weighted / simple gain: what your total capital actually did, including the timing of deposits. Benchmark: compare against what you'd have got doing something simple: holding the same assets, or plain stablecoin lending. Beating zero isn't the test. Attribution: split the result into sources: price moves, fees, interest, incentives, costs, losses. Only the parts you control show skill.
scenes.cap: Time-weighted return (TWR): chains the return of each period, ignoring when you added or removed money. It measures your decisions. Money-weighted / simple gain: what your total capital actually did, including the timing of deposits. Benchmark: compare against what you'd have got doing something simple: holding the same assets, or plain stablecoin lending. Beating zero isn't the test. Attribution: split the result into sources: price moves, fees, interest, incentives, costs, losses. Only the parts you control show skill.

scenes.title: Worked example
scenes.vo: Start $100,000 to +10% in Q1 ($110,000) to deposit $50,000 ($160,000) to minus 5% in Q2 to $152,000. the calculator Then compare 4.50% with holding ETH over the same period, and with stablecoin lending. time-weighted return: 1.10 times 0.95 minus 1 = 4.50% (your decisions) Simple gain on $150,000 put in: 1.33% (hurt by the deposit landing before a down quarter)
scenes.cap: TWR: 1.10 × 0.95 − 1 = 4.50% (your decisions) Simple gain on $150,000 put in: 1.33% (hurt by the deposit landing before a down quarter)
